reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Dehiwala tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
WhatsApp from field staff (05:00): Beruwala site eka dead machan, cabinet lights off, need equipment team
Call centre: 11 customers around Payagala say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Beruwala tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CLEARED | BER22 Beruwala RBS | all sectors in service

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

finding.finding: Policy weights remain unchanged: S02 is approved critical (weight 5); all other services are standard (weight 1). No credible outage is established. S01 equipment status is unknown, while the later authoritative snapshot says Beruwala (S01) is cleared and all sectors are in service; the earlier unverified message does not establish an outage. Other supplied reports are excluded as operational evidence. No priority change is warranted.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

finding.explanation: Prediction from verified evidence; unknown assets are conservatively unavailable. Unmet needs may remain.

findings: The plan has no actions, so no target, timing, travel, or arithmetic checks are needed.

REP-001 refers to Beruwala, matching site S01 (BER22). It reports cabinet lights off and asks for an equipment team, but it is an unverified message and does not establish a verified equipment fault. The unresolved equipment status is appropriately treated as unknown.

The plan defers work on the unknown asset and records the unmet need. The other reports do not establish an operational claim that changes this decision: the utility notice is a future outage for a location with no matching directory site, the Payagala complaint does not establish an asset condition, and the Beruwala repair rumour is unconfirmed.
